args.title: Launch arguments
args.description: Added to every Claude Code start in a tmuxedo pane, in this order.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model Claude Code starts with (--model). Empty leaves Claude Code's own choice.

skipPermissions.title: Never ask for permission
skipPermissions.x-dangerous: Claude runs commands and changes files without asking. Use it only in a place you can throw away.

extras.title: Load tmuxedo extras
extras.description: The tmuxedo skill and the items you enable here. Off starts the agent with only what you set up yourself.
